title: Pure Die Roll
summary: The Die Roll strategy unites Yu-Gi-Oh!'s strongest six-sided die-rolling monsters and Spells/Traps—led by Orgoth the Relentless, Snipe Hunter, Dice Jar, Dimension Dice, and That Six. With That Six guaranteeing favorable rolls, Snipe Hunter destroys opposing boards reliably, Dice Jar deals massive burn damage, and Number 85: Crazy Box and Masterking Archfiend provide Extra Deck utility.

allow.Skull Archfiend of Lightning: 2500 ATK Fiend that rolls a six-sided die whenever targeted by an opponent's card effect and negates/destroys it on a 1, 3, or 6.
allow.Blind Destruction: Continuous Trap that rolls a six-sided die during every Standby Phase and destroys all face-up monsters on the field whose Level equals the result.
allow.Masterking Archfiend: Link-2 Fiend that rolls a die whenever a Fiend is sent to the GY to add it to hand, shuffle it to Deck, or Special Summon it.

main: Orgoth the Relentless
Signature Level 7 Warrior that rolls a six-sided die 3 times to gain ATK/DEF x 100 and unlock battle/effect immunity, direct attacks, or double attacks based on matching/high rolls.
Snipe Hunter
Discards 1 card to target any card on the field and roll a die; destroys the target on anything except a 1 or 6 (100% guaranteed destruction while That Six is face-up!).
Dice Jar
Flip monster where both players roll a six-sided die and the loser takes burn damage equal to the winner's roll x 500 (or exactly 6000 damage if the winner rolls a 6!).
Maximum Six
Rolls a die when Tribute Summoned and gains ATK equal to the result x 200.
Skull Archfiend of Lightning
2500 ATK Fiend that rolls a six-sided die whenever targeted by an opponent's card effect and negates/destroys it on a 1, 3, or 6.
That Six
Core Continuous Trap: every time either player rolls a die, you can turn any 1, 3, or 5 into a 6, OR turn any 2, 4, or 6 into a 1 (rigging Dice Jar, Snipe Hunter, and Orgoth!).
Dimension Dice
Tributes 1 monster you control while you control a card with a die-roll effect to Special Summon Orgoth the Relentless or any die-roll monster directly from your hand or Deck.
Summon Dice
Pays 1000 LP and rolls a die to grant an extra Normal Summon (1-2), revive a monster from the GY (3-4), or Special Summon a Level 5+ monster from the hand (5-6).
Dicephoon
Quick-Play Spell that rolls a die to destroy 1 Spell/Trap on the field (2, 3, 4) or 2 Spells/Traps on the field (5).
Graceful Dice
Quick-Play Spell that rolls a die and boosts the ATK/DEF of all monsters you currently control by the result x 100.
Skull Dice
Trap that rolls a die and reduces the ATK/DEF of all monsters your opponent currently controls by the result x 100.
Blind Destruction
Continuous Trap that rolls a die every Standby Phase to destroy all monsters matching that Level.
extra: Rank 4 Xyz with 3000 ATK that detaches 1 material to roll a six-sided die for various effects.
Link-2 Fiend that rolls a die whenever a Fiend is sent to the GY.
